function.arguments: {"observation": "The `patient_id` column has 48 duplicate values, meaning 48 patients appear more than once in the dataset. Each such patient has two rows with different `sample_seq` values (e.g., P001 appears twice: sample_seq=1 and sample_seq=2).", "implication": "If we do not deduplicate, we will double-count these patients, which biases the mean baseline biomarker value. The data dictionary specifies that the row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for the same patient. Therefore, we must deduplicate on `patient_id`, keeping only the row with the maximum `sample_seq` per patient before computing the mean."}
function.name: note_finding
